name: Cube Assembly
description: Design and check missing-polycube puzzles for irregular target stacks with fixed orientations or proper rigid rotations.
steps: Select a pattern and inspect its representative original
Record the intended inference, condition, closest foil and distinguishing evidence
Choose a mechanism and model the geometry
Solve each option and inspect the final media
Check the declared inference and revise the named option or condition if needed
Publish the reviewed task and evidence
